module origen_204408(
    input clk,
    input enable,
    output [7:0] dir,
    output reset,
    output WR,
    output RD,
    output ready
);

    reg [9:0] clkr;
    reg [2:0] next;
    reg [2:0] state;
    reg [7:0] dir_reg;
    reg reset_reg, WR_reg, RD_reg, ready_reg;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (enable) begin
            if (state == 2'b00) begin
                dir_reg <= dir_reg + 1;
                next <= 2'b01;
            end
            else if (state == 2'b01) begin
                reset_reg <= 1;
                if (WR_reg == 0)
                    next <= 2'b10;
            end
            else if (state == 2'b10) begin
                WR_reg <= 0;
                if (dir_reg == 8'b00001010) begin
                    ready_reg <= 1;
                    dir_reg <= 8'b00000001;
                end
                else
                    next <= 2'b00;
            end

            if (clkr == 9'b100000001) begin
                reset_reg <= 0;
                WR_reg <= 0;
                clkr <= 0;
            end
            else
                clkr <= clkr + 1;

            state <= next;
        end
    end

    assign dir = dir_reg;
    assign reset = reset_reg;
    assign WR = WR_reg;
    assign RD = RD_reg;
    assign ready = ready_reg;

endmodule
